profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Full-Stack Python/Django | AI / LLM Systems | Distributed Systems (Ex-Telecom)
profile.summary:
Senior full-stack software engineer with 10+ years building and operating production systems, internal platforms, and AI-powered products.

Hands-on across the stack, with a backend-first focus: designing data pipelines, APIs, async workers, and user-facing workflows in complex domains.

Strong experience integrating LLMs for document processing, classification, and summarization, and improving reliability, performance, and maintainability of systems in production.

Background in electronic engineering with a strong systems mindset and a track record of moving into new domains quickly.

projects.title: UpperLayer
projects.description: UpperLayer is a business intelligence tool for telecom companies that allows them to get insights of the performance of their networks through basic metrics and Key Performance Indicators (KPI). UpperLayer is a software as a service (SaaS) that combines statistical information from multiple networks (2G, 3G and 4G) and from different vendors in one web application interface with normalized parameters to enhance data analysis.
